name: Pack Intimidation [Combat, Teamwork]
body:
You draw on the strength of numbers and your shared convictions to intimidate your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc, intimidating ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever your allies use the Intimidate skill to demoralize foes, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check for every ally within 30 feet who also uses Intimidate this turn. Whenever you use Intimidate all allies within 30 ft. receive a +2 circumstance bonus on any intimidate checks they make. These bonuses stack to a maximum of +6.
